summary: Abetment of suicide conviction under IPC s.306; reliance on suicide note (Ex.33) in deceased's handwriting; postmortem confirms poisoning; failure to recover money/ornaments not fatal; conjoint evaluation of oral and documentary evidence supports conviction; absence of appellants at scene not determinative; possession of compromising material for blackmail established; prosecution proved charge beyond reasonable doubt; convictions upheld.
legal_provisions_cited: Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 s.3(2)(5)
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; conviction and sentence under Section 306/114 IPC upheld.
